question: Which fast food restaurant can be found west of UCONN Stamford Dorms, Stamford, CT inside a 60 kilometers range?
sql:
WITH origin AS  (SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-73.542555 41.052229)',4326)::geography AS geometry)
SELECT * FROM pois, origin
WHERE ST_DWithin(pois.geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-73.542555 41.052229)',4326)::geography, 60000)
AND amenity = 'fast_food'
AND degrees(ST_Azimuth(origin.geometry, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN 247.5 AND 292.5;
